about: Plimsoll note definitions, read by packages/mcp and packages/attestor. The file holds only what the chain cannot say: the network holding the backing, the vault list (the preimage of the vaultSetHash registered in CoverageOracle), whether the note is a negative control, and where the on-chain facts live. Everything else is read from the chain at the time of use and is never configured here: outstanding (the note's totalSupply), par (its nominalValue), the threshold (LoadLine) and the holder (the note's issuer, the sole ROLE_ISSUER member). Keys are noteId = keccak256(market). Run scripts/check_notes.py after every edit.

0x376011be372685b3e6d566a7ba172f8b8968ac.comment: The negative control. Its real on-chain obligation is 10,000 notes at a nominal of 100.00, so $1,000,000 against roughly $15 of backing, and it must always refuse. Its registered vaultSetHash 0x2627c1d5... is sha256('plimsoll/vaults/v1'), a bootstrap placeholder, not the hash of any vault list; setVaultSet replaces it once the vaults are final.

0xb51023289ff2160bbde35658811ef0a869f6e2.comment: The right-sized series: a $10.00 on-chain obligation (1,000 base units at 2 decimals, nominal 100 at 2 decimals) against roughly $15 of Base backing, so it is the note that should clear. ISIN US0000PLIMB4, Hedera 0.0.10482316.
